translations.web: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
translations.bsb: A man’s pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honor.
translations.kjv: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
translations.asv: A man's pride shall bring him low; But he that is of a lowly spirit shall obtain honor.
